name: AnySplat
definition: Pose-free feed-forward network: a single forward pass over uncalibrated image collections yields 3D Gaussian primitives plus per-image intrinsics and extrinsics.
summary: AnySplat is a pose-free feed-forward network that reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from uncalibrated images without camera pose annotations, scaling to sparse or dense captures in a single pass.
